name: 果蝇诱捕器厨房静置摆放款
description: 厨房多处点位布放，机身视窗结构，清爽无脏乱的驱虫套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless #FFFFFF for packshots, brushed studio slate #6E7780 for benefit claims, solid accent panel #F2691E for mechanism and option screens, warm off-white #F7F4EF linen for info and contents spreads
styleLock.lightingSystem: neutral-cool soft studio light, front-left key with bounce fill, true contact shadows, one skimming edge highlight on shell texture, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: kitchen worktop language: veined marble backsplash #EDE7E1, clay counter #D9A48E, polished dark stone #26262A, matte graphite plate #3A3F44
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, headline set inside one solid accent band, short callout labels only
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and white #FFFFFF numbered circles, single weight, one accent only
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the unit across the set; pests never shown as creatures, only as abstract arcs or empty space
noDrift: no visible insects or pests in any frame
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium pest-control home care visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless background #FFFFFF, warm off-white field #F7F4EF, brushed studio slate #6E7780 and one persimmon accent panel #F2691E; neutral-cool soft studio lighting with a front-left key, bounce fill, true contact shadows and one skimming edge highlight; modern geometric sans-serif with headlines set inside one solid accent band; consistent thin-line icons and white #FFFFFF numbered circles; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no visible pests.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击：整排同款机身与零售盒在纯白场里成立，先讲清买到的是一组
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level lineup, units evenly spaced in one row, retail carton at a slight 3/4 beside them
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, soft front-left key with bounce fill on the shadow side, true contact shadows
shots.whitespace: none, centered lineup with even edge margins
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A straight-on eye-level lineup: several identical units of {product} standing in one evenly spaced row on a seamless background #FFFFFF, every unit fully visible and not cropped, with its retail carton shown once at a slight 3/4 angle at the left end of the row. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a soft front-left key and a bounce card on the shadow side, true contact shadows grounding each unit. The row occupies 60-70% of the frame and is centered, with no extra whitespace at the edges. 8K, commercial home-care e-commerce quality. Negative: no text, no badge, no star rating, no country flag, no review count, no watermark, no fake logo, no hands, no insects, no floating product, no cut-off edges, no gradient background.

shots.intent: 一秒核心主张：机身立在厨房台面上，用抽象趋附动线说明诱集发生在哪里
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle shot from counter height, unit on the lower left
shots.lighting: soft key from the upper left with gentle falloff toward the back wall, soft contact shadow, 5500K
shots.props: one out-of-focus fruit bunch far right for depth
shots.whitespace: generous negative space across the top 45% for the headline
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at a slight 3/4 angle from counter height on a brushed studio slate backdrop #6E7780, the unit on the lower left and one blurred fruit bunch pushed to the far right edge for depth. A bold headline in #FFFFFF modern geometric sans-serif sits in the upper left reading 「{selling_point_1}」, with generous negative space kept across the top 45% for copy. Soft key light from the upper left, gentle falloff to the back, soft contact shadow under the base. The unit occupies 50-60% of the frame. The attraction idea is conveyed only by three thin #FFFFFF concentric arcs rising above the vented dome, never by any creature. Negative: no flies, no insects, no bugs, no larvae, no dead pests, no readable brand mark, no watermark, no invented efficacy claim, no second headline, no props covering the product.

shots.displayName: 厨房四处藏匿点四宫格
shots.intent: 放大痛点：把问题落到买家自己的厨房角落，四个真实点位对号入座
shots.camera: four matched eye-level vignettes in a two-by-two grid, identical crop in every panel
shots.lighting: natural daylight from the left in each panel, 5500K, honest shadows, no studio polish
shots.background: warm off-white frame #F7F4EF with one solid accent band #F2691E across the top
shots.props: a woven fruit bowl, a sink edge with a small plant, an open counter run, a lidded waste bin
shots.whitespace: clean even gutters between the four panels
shots.textZone: top accent band plus one short label bar per panel
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point screen: one solid accent band #F2691E across the top carrying a bold #FFFFFF headline reading 「{selling_point_2}」, and below it a two-by-two grid of four matched eye-level kitchen vignettes on a warm off-white frame #F7F4EF, showing a fruit bowl on a table, a sink edge beside a window, an open counter run with a paper roll, and a lidded waste bin under a cabinet. Each panel carries one short label bar in #F2691E with #FFFFFF text reading 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. {product} appears in only one panel, small and unposed on the counter. Natural daylight from the left in every panel, 5500K, honest shadows, identical crop and framing across all four panels. Each vignette keeps the scene at 40-50% occupancy with clean gutters between panels. Negative: no insects, no flies, no larvae, no mould, no rotting produce, no plastic-looking fruit, no unrealistic portion size, no identifiable person or face, no torso in frame, no watermark, no fake logo, no dense body text.

shots.intent: 机制解释：俯拍进气孔阵与入口结构，讲清原理而不喊口号
shots.camera: photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle for the vented dome, with a second unit at a slight 3/4 beside it
shots.lighting: even flat studio light plus one skimming highlight tracing the dome rim, no harsh speculars
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the right 40% for callouts
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic mechanism screen on a solid accent panel #F2691E. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. {product} is shown twice in the same frame: photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle so the vented dome pattern reads clearly, and again at a slight 3/4 angle beside it so the entry opening and the sight window are legible. Even flat studio light with one skimming highlight tracing the dome rim, no harsh speculars, soft contact shadows under both views. Two white #FFFFFF numbered circles sit at the lower left with short labels reading 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」, leaving generous negative space on the right 40% for copy. The overhead view occupies 50-60% of the frame. Negative: no insects, no pests entering or escaping, no trapped catch shown, no invented arrows pointing at nothing, no watermark, no fake logo, no tiny unreadable text, no color palette change.

shots.intent: 用真实材质与做工细节证明品质：视窗、壳体接缝与哑光表面
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, tight zoom on the sight window and shell seam, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: skimming side light from the right revealing matte texture, controlled single highlight, no blowout
shots.whitespace: minimal, the detail is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the translucent sight window and on the seam where the two shell halves meet. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field, foreground edge sharp, rear of the body falling into soft blur. Skimming side light from the right reveals the fine matte grain and the mold line without blowing out highlights. Matte graphite plate background #3A3F44. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with minimal surrounding whitespace. Negative: no blurry subject, no insects or any catch inside the chamber, no liquid spill, no scratched or melted plastic, no over-smoothed plastic sheen, no watermark, no extra text, no fake logo, no props.

shots.intent: 使用步骤代入：一只手把诱芯放下去就完事，消除操作门槛
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle from counter height with a candid unstaged feel, hand entering from the right
shots.lighting: soft daylight from the left, 5500K, gentle shadows, honest contact shadow under both units
shots.background: veined marble backsplash #EDE7E1 over a clay counter #D9A48E
shots.props: one slim lure sachet, a second unit and the retail carton set back-left as a scale anchor
shots.whitespace: open band across the top for the headline
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle usage scene: {product} standing open on a clay counter #D9A48E in front of a veined marble backsplash #EDE7E1, one generic hand with no jewellery and no identifiable person lowering a slim lure sachet toward the body. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at a slight 3/4 angle from counter height with a candid, unstaged feel. Soft daylight from the left, 5500K, gentle shadows, honest contact shadows under the unit and under the second unit placed back-left with the retail carton as a scale anchor. A solid accent band #F2691E across the top carries a bold #FFFFFF headline reading 「{selling_point_3}」. The main unit occupies 40-50% of the frame. Negative: no face, no extra or fused fingers, no distorted hand joint, no hand covering the product, no spilled liquid, no sachet text legible, no watermark, no fake logo, no dense body text.

shots.intent: 自我投射：食物储备旁的安静安放，说明它在家里的存在感有多低
shots.camera: very low angle at surface level looking slightly upward, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: single soft key from the upper right, deep falloff, clean mirror reflection on the surface, 4500K
shots.background: polished dark stone counter #26262A with warm out-of-focus fruit dish far behind
shots.props: one blurred fruit in a pale dish, well behind the product
shots.whitespace: generous negative space in the upper left for copy
shots.promptTemplate: Moody lifestyle scene: {product} resting on a polished dark stone counter #26262A, photographed from a very low angle at surface level looking slightly upward, with a softly blurred fruit dish far behind in warm bokeh. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Single soft key from the upper right with deep falloff, a clean mirror-like reflection on the surface and one real contact shadow under the base that matches the light direction. Shallow depth of field with the near edge sharp. A headline in bold #FFFFFF modern geometric sans-serif sits in the upper left reading 「{selling_point_4}」, with generous negative space around it. The unit occupies 40-50% of the frame. Negative: no hands, no people, no insects, no clutter, no impossible reflection mismatched with the light, no over-retouched plastic sheen, no watermark, no fake logo, no star rating, no footnote line.

shots.intent: 让买家挑：单只与整盒并排同光同比例，一次看清可选组合
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level group lineup, identical crop and scale for every arrangement
shots.lighting: bright even studio light, soft front key, consistent contact shadows across the group
shots.props: loose lure sachets between the units
shots.whitespace: generous negative space beneath the lineup for short labels
shots.textZone: upper left headline with blank label strips under each group
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant screen on a solid accent field #F2691E. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. {product} shown as a family lineup: a single unit, a paired group and a boxed group arranged left to right with even gaps, all photographed straight-on at eye-level with identical lighting, identical angle and identical scale. Loose lure sachets lie flat between the groups as neutral props. Bright even studio light with a soft front key and consistent contact shadows. A bold #FFFFFF headline at the upper left reads 「{selling_point_5}」, and one blank unprinted label strip sits under each group for post-production text. The group occupies 60-70% overall with generous negative space beneath it. Negative: no mixed lighting between items, no scale drift between groups, no invented pack counts, no printed numbers on the label strips, no readable brand mark, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text.

shots.intent: 收口降风险：摊开全部到货内容，配空参数条与空印章框供真实资料后贴
shots.camera: flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow, soft contact edges under each item
shots.props: inner packaging and sachets laid on a grid, two blank seal outlines, one empty parameter strip
shots.whitespace: generous negative space along the top for a single line
shots.textZone: lower right blank proof strip sized for two short callouts
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen, a flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle on a warm off-white linen field #F7F4EF. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. {product} is laid out with its sachets and inner packaging in one tidy spaced row on a grid. Even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow, soft contact edges under every item. The spread occupies 35-40% of the frame, with generous negative space along the top for a single line. Two blank seal outlines and one empty parameter strip with unprinted rows sit at the lower right, sized for 「{callout_5}」 and 「{callout_6}」 to be set in post. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, lab results, ratings, durations or counts; no readable badge text, no printed digits, no country flag, no watermark, no fake logo, no clutter, no insects.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：首图为零售盒与整排同款圆鼓机身并列于纯白场；第二图为冷灰台面近摄，机身上方有多点趋附物与粗体主张标题；第三图为三行安心清单式卖点图（不脏乱、融入家居、易查看），旁置诱芯袋与果盘；第四图为橙色实底上顶部孔阵俯拍加侧面机身，配两个编号圆点说明机制；第五图为手持诱芯袋投入机身，大理石墙与陶土台面；第六图为四宫格点位图（果盘、水槽、台面、垃圾桶）加橙色标题带；第七图为橙色实底配台历道具强调更换节奏；第八图为暗调抛光台面静置场景，浅景深；第九图为另一款管道杀虫气雾剂的引流广告。品类判定依据：源类目常挂家居清洁，实物为无电无加热的室内物理诱捕小件，按图判为家居日用/驱虫，不归家用电器或医药保健。已剥离内容：原品牌字标与系列名、原平台店铺字样、零售盒上的全部英文原句与排名及社会证明主张、脚注、星条旗标、诱芯时长与盒装件数等一切数值，一律改为空参数条与空印章框；含虫画面全部改写为抽象趋附动线与留空结构并逐镜加负面清单；第九图的另款产品不入本套，仅回收其纯色实底加右置产品的排版语法；人物仅保留颈部以下与手部。
